description: This file implements the SQL store for managing read receipts in a messaging application, including methods for saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving read receipt data, as well as counting unread receipts for posts.

classes.name: SqlReadReceiptStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the store for read receipts, including database connection and query builder.

methods.name: newSqlReadReceiptStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlReadReceiptStore instance.

methods.name: InvalidateReadReceiptForPostsCache
methods.description: Placeholder method for invalidating cache related to read receipts for posts.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new read receipt record to the database.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing read receipt record in the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific read receipt based on postID and userID.

methods.name: DeleteByPost
methods.description: Deletes all read receipts associated with a specific post.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific read receipt for a given postID and userID.

methods.name: GetByPost
methods.description: Retrieves all read receipts for a specific post.

methods.name: GetReadCountForPost
methods.description: Returns the count of read receipts for a specific post.

methods.name: GetUnreadCountForPost
methods.description: Calculates the number of users who haven't read a specific post.
